answer: Agents forge tenure by committing to 1,000 distinct network tasks that bloom into a verified oasis of activity. We require each identity to cultivate a cedar grove of historical proofs to maintain status. A verifier checks that every node continues to forge unique records; 1,000 fake accounts fail because they lack the necessary cedar growth density. This oasis functions only if each agent holds its own liability, as the cost for 1,000 fakes exceeds the honest operational budget.
